Downtown Tucson.name: Downtown Tucson
Downtown Tucson.description: Congress Street core with the Fox Tucson Theatre, the Rio Nuevo redevelopment blocks, and adaptive-reuse of the warehouse district's commercial stock.

Armory Park.name: Armory Park
Armory Park.description: Historic residential district south of the convention center with Victorian and Sonoran rowhouse restoration and the Tucson Museum of Art edge.

Barrio Viejo.name: Barrio Viejo
Barrio Viejo.description: Sonoran rowhouse barrio west of I-10 with adobe rehabilitation, courtyarded short-stay conversions, and the Convento cultural frontage.

Fourth Avenue.name: Fourth Avenue
Fourth Avenue.description: Historic merchant strip between downtown and campus with storefront retail, patio-dining infill, and the streetcar-linked foot-traffic economy.

University of Arizona.name: University of Arizona
University of Arizona.description: Main Gate and campus corridor with student-housing turnover, lab and tech-transfer adjacency, and the university's anchor-institution demand.

Midtown.name: Midtown
Midtown.description: Broadway and Speedway midtown belt with post-war commercial strip retrofit, medical office demand, and the Grant/Alvernon rental core.

Catalina Foothills edge.name: Catalina Foothills edge
Catalina Foothills edge.description: Skyline and Campbell foothills belt with luxury resort adjacency, view-lot renovation, and the metro's top valuation band at the Santa Catalinas.

Oro Valley edge.name: Oro Valley edge
Oro Valley edge.description: Northwest master-planned edge along Oracle Road and La Cañada with golf-community stock, Innovation Park biotech adjacency, and steady license growth.
